crossRefs.note: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.
Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.
Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: “By the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one portion.
translations.bsb: And Gad will have one portion bordering the territory of Zebulun from east to west.
